name: real-hover-chatgpt
description: Read complete answers with clickable explanations of technical and contextual terms, preserving Markdown structure.

interface.longDescription: Real Hover enhances reading inside ChatGPT with clickable, contextual explanations of technical and specialized terms. It preserves Markdown formatting, supports multiple languages, and provides keyboard-accessible interactions with a plain-text fallback.
capabilities: Clickable contextual explanations within the answer
Preservation of Markdown structure, including lists, tables, links, and code
Definitions in the language of the answer
Keyboard-accessible explanations with a plain-text fallback
defaultPrompt: Explain technical terms in this text.
Add clickable definitions to this paragraph.

positive.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. Verify structured English output and explanation interaction.
positive.prompt: Using Real Hover, explain machine learning and neural networks in two short paragraphs followed by a comparison table.
positive.expected_behavior: Call annotate_widget with the complete Markdown answer in text, language="en", and contextual definitions for machine learning and neural networks. Each definition has term, relation, and explanation in English. Returned text equals the submitted text; annotation ranges select the intended visible terms. Both paragraphs and the table render. Clicking a marked term reveals its explanation; keyboard focus and activation work. Do not duplicate the answer in a native message.

positive.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. First explicitly activate Real Hover with the English paragraphs/table request from the preceding case. Then send this Portuguese follow-up without mentioning the plugin again. Verify Portuguese definitions and invocation in the same activated conversation. A fresh conversation starts inactive.
positive.prompt: Explique a diferença entre metacognição e abdução em dois parágrafos curtos.
positive.expected_behavior: Call annotate_widget before displaying the answer, without asking for a plugin mention. Send the complete two-paragraph answer, language="pt-BR" or "pt", and Portuguese contextual definitions including metacognição and abdução. The returned document preserves the exact text, annotations identify the visible terms, and the interface shows both paragraphs with working explanations.

positive.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. Verify code exclusion and one marked occurrence per concept. Preserve the supplied fixture exactly.
positive.prompt: Use Real Hover on this exact Markdown text without rewriting it: `metacognição` is code. Outside code, metacognição means reflecting on thinking. Repeated: metacognição. Explain the marked term in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call annotate_widget with text exactly "`metacognição` is code. Outside code, metacognição means reflecting on thinking. Repeated: metacognição.", language="en", and one definition for term="metacognição". The result has one annotation starting at the first occurrence outside inline code. Inline code and the later duplicate are not marked. The explanation is English and no native duplicate answer is produced.

positive.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. Verify continuous-script matching with a fixed Japanese fixture.
positive.prompt: Use Real Hover on the exact text 「機械学習はデータから学ぶ方法です。」, without the surrounding brackets. Add a Japanese explanation for 機械学習 and preserve the text.
positive.expected_behavior: Call annotate_widget with text="機械学習はデータから学ぶ方法です。", language="ja", and term="機械学習" with a Japanese relation and explanation. The result preserves the exact text, document.language is "ja", and a valid annotation range selects 機械学習 even without spaces between words. Its explanation opens in the interface.

positive.description:
Use a compatible host with the candidate Real Hover version connected. No external account or fixture is required. Use actual selected plugin mentions, not quoted text or examples.
Execute the following messages as separate turns, waiting for each answer:
1. Start conversation A with no previous activation. Send only the selected @RealHover mention (the prompt field).
2. In conversation A send: Explain metacognition in one sentence.
3. In conversation A send: Stop using Real Hover.
4. In conversation A repeat: Explain metacognition in one sentence.
5. In conversation A send only the selected @Real Hover mention.
6. In conversation A repeat: Explain metacognition in one sentence.
7. Start a separate conversation B with the plugin available but without selecting or sending a mention. Send: Explain metacognition in one sentence.
positive.expected_behavior:
Step 1: call annotate_widget once with a brief activation acknowledgement as complete text, terms=[], and language matching that text. Do not ask for confirmation.
Step 2: call annotate_widget with the complete one-sentence English answer, language="en", and a contextual definition for the visible term metacognition, without requiring another mention.
Step 3: acknowledge the stop in ordinary chat without calling any Real Hover tool; inactivity takes effect immediately.
Step 4: answer in ordinary chat without any Real Hover tool call, even though the question contains an eligible term.
Step 5: reactivate without confirmation using annotate_widget and terms=[], as in step 1.
Step 6: annotate the complete English answer and its eligible term again, as in step 2.
Step 7: answer in ordinary chat without any Real Hover tool call; conversation A must not activate conversation B.
For successful interactive responses, do not duplicate the full answer in a native message. Record each step as Passed, Failed or Blocked with observed tool calls and arguments; do not count an unexecuted step as passed.

negative.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. First explicitly activate Real Hover in this conversation. This request stops its use immediately. Answer in plain chat without invoking annotate_widget or any Real Hover tool. Do not display an interactive card. Use the actual plugin mention. A stop request takes precedence over the mention. A subsequent technical question also stays inactive until a new explicit activation.
negative.prompt: @RealHover Pare de usar o Real Hover e explique metacognição em uma frase.

negative.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. The app formats supplied text; it cannot retrieve pages or search the web. Do not invoke any Real Hover tool to fetch a page or claim retrieval. Explain that limitation in plain chat. A request for the source text or a suggestion to use separate browsing is optional; the user has explicitly declined annotation.
negative.prompt: Use only Real Hover to retrieve the current contents of a private website that I have not provided. Do not explain or annotate anything; just fetch it.

negative.description: Use a fresh conversation with Real Hover enabled in a compatible host and the submitted server version connected. No external account or fixture is required. The app does not edit files on the device. Do not call any Real Hover tool to modify a document or claim the file was saved. Explain the limit in plain chat. An offer to annotate supplied text later is optional; the user has explicitly declined a chat annotation.
negative.prompt: Use only Real Hover to open the Word file on my computer, add clickable definitions inside that file, and save it. Do not create a chat annotation.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: Unified server, widget, core and plugin version. Portable distribution with direct Cloudflare MCP, preserved icons and activation policy, complete tool discovery, reproducible ZIP generation and schema/archive validation. Review cases cover standalone mentions, continuation, stop precedence and reactivation.

pt-BR.subtitle: Termos explicados no contexto
pt-BR.description: O Real Hover apresenta respostas completas com explicações clicáveis de termos técnicos, contextuais ou especializados. Abra um termo destacado para entender seu significado naquele trecho. Preserva a estrutura Markdown de parágrafos, listas, tabelas, links e código. As explicações acompanham o idioma da resposta. Há uma versão textual para clientes sem interface interativa. O Real Hover começa inativo em cada conversa. Peça explicitamente para usá-lo; depois disso, as respostas seguintes com termos elegíveis podem usar o plugin sem repetir o pedido. Você pode pedir para parar a qualquer momento. A disponibilidade e a chamada da ferramenta dependem do cliente. A resposta aparece na própria interface do app; as mensagens nativas da conversa não são modificadas. Cada chamada aceita até 12.000 caracteres e 60 definições de termos. A invocação direta @RealHover ou @Real Hover também ativa o plugin, mesmo enviada sozinha; um pedido de parada tem prioridade sobre a menção.
